bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 40; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atq -c "SELECT 'ROOM_TOPICS='||count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE enabled AND purpose='room'; SELECT 'ANNOUNCEMENT_TOPICS='||count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE enabled AND purpose='announcement'; SELECT 'ROOM_RELEASE_GATE='||coalesce(bool_or(enabled),'false') FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='room'; SELECT 'ANN_RELEASE_GATE='||coalesce(bool_or(enabled),'false') FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='announcement'; SELECT 'PENDING_NOTIFICATION_COUNT='||count(*) FROM announcement_notifications WHERE state IN ('pending','sending','needs_reconcile'); SELECT 'PENDING_ROOM_EVENT_COUNT='||count(*) FROM room_source_events WHERE state='pending';" | grep -E '^(ROOM_TOPICS|ANNOUNCEMENT_TOPICS|ROOM_RELEASE_GATE|ANN_RELEASE_GATE|PENDING_NOTIFICATION_COUNT|PENDING_ROOM_EVENT_COUNT)=' || exit 43
